newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - ISD 12 Circle Pines, Minn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - ISD 12 Circle Pines, Minn..

text.p: General Obligation School Building Bonds, Series 1997A
Proposals for the Bonds will be received on
until 12:00 Noon, Central Time, at the office of Springsted Incorporated, 85 East Seventh Place, Suite 100, Saint Paul, Minnesota, after which time they will be opened and
tabulated. Consideration for award of the Bonds will be by the School Board at 7:30 P.M., Central Time, of the same day.

Proposals may be submitted in a sealed envelope or by fax (612) 223-3002 to Springsted. Signed Proposals, without final price or coupons, may be submitted to Springsted prior to the time of sale as described more fully in the Terms of Proposal. Proposals may also be filed electronically via PARITY, in accordance with PARITY Rules of Participation as described more fully in the Terms of Proposal.
The Bonds will be dated April 1, 1997, as the date of original issue, and will bear interest payable on June 1 and December 1 of each year, commencing December 1, 1997.
The Bonds will mature June 1 in the years and amounts as follows:

2004 $150,000 2008 $300,000 2012 $400,000 2016 $ 900,000 2005 $200,000 2009 $400,000 2013 $800,000 2017 $4,000,000 The District may elect on June 1, 2008, and on any day thereafter, to prepay Bonds due on or after June 1, 2009 as described more fully in the Terms of Proposal.

For copies of the Official Statement or for any additional information prior to sale, any prospective purchaser is referred to the Financial Advisor to the District, Springsted Incorporated at the above address, phone (612) 223-3000.
BY ORDER OF THE SCHOOL BOARD
